about_page.hero_desc: We design and deliver industrial automation systems engineered for reliability, precision, and long-term production performance.
about_page.who_content: Malus Robotics is an industrial automation engineering firm focused on designing, programming, and commissioning control systems for modern manufacturing environments. We specialize in PLC programming, robotics integration, motion control, and digitally validated automation systems.
about_page.how_content: We don't treat automation as isolated hardware or software. Every project is approached as a complete system — control logic, motion, safety, data, and lifecycle support working together as a single engineered solution.
about_page.p1_desc: We approach automation as an engineering discipline — not a product catalog. Every system is designed for reliability, determinism, and long-term performance.
about_page.p2_desc: Our solutions are engineered for real factory floors — continuous operation, harsh environments, and mission-critical production systems.
about_page.p3_desc: We design systems that scale, evolve, and remain maintainable across years of production — not short-term demos.

project_assembly.hero_desc: This project demonstrates Malus Robotics' capability to design, simulate, validate, and commission a complete automotive assembly line using advanced PLC programming, robotics integration, and digital twin–based virtual commissioning methodologies.
project_assembly.summary_desc: The automotive assembly line was engineered to support high-volume production with strict quality and safety requirements. Malus Robotics delivered a fully integrated automation system by combining robotics, PLC control, and digital twin validation. Virtual commissioning was employed extensively to test logic, sequencing, safety behavior, and robot coordination prior to physical deployment, significantly reducing commissioning risk and on-site downtime.

privacy_page.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect information across our robots, apps, and website. Effective {date}.
privacy_page.contact_body: Write to us at {email} and we'll get back to you.
privacy_page.sec_overview_body1: Malüs Robotics designs and builds robotic systems, and the software and cloud services that run them. This policy explains what information we collect when you buy our hardware, use our apps, or visit our website, and how we handle it.
privacy_page.sec_overview_body2: You can browse our public site without telling us who you are. We only need information from you at specific points — creating an account, registering a device, or contacting support.
privacy_page.sec_collect_body1: We collect a few different categories of information, depending on how you interact with us:
privacy_page.sec_collect_list1: Account details — name, email, shipping address, and phone number when you register, order, or contact support.
privacy_page.sec_collect_list2: Device and operational data — telemetry, sensor logs, firmware version, error reports, and diagnostic data sent from your robot to help it run and to help us maintain it.
privacy_page.sec_collect_list3: Usage data — how you interact with our apps and dashboards, including feature usage and session activity.
privacy_page.sec_collect_list4: Site analytics — anonymized traffic and browsing data collected through cookies, described further below.
privacy_page.sec_use_body1: We use collected information to operate, secure, and improve our products: to authenticate your account, deliver firmware and software updates, provide support, monitor device health and safety, and understand how our products are used so we can improve them.
privacy_page.sec_use_body2: We do not use sensor or telemetry data to build advertising profiles.
privacy_page.sec_sharing_body1: Malüs Robotics does not sell your personal information. We share it with non-affiliated companies only:
privacy_page.sec_sharing_list1: To provide a product or service you've requested, or with your permission.
privacy_page.sec_sharing_list2: With trusted vendors who work on our behalf under confidentiality agreements — for example, cloud hosting or shipping partners. They may not use your data beyond what we've instructed.
privacy_page.sec_sharing_list3: In response to a subpoena, court order, or other legal process.
privacy_page.sec_sharing_list4: When we believe it's necessary to investigate or prevent fraud, illegal activity, or a threat to anyone's physical safety.
privacy_page.sec_sharing_list5: If Malüs Robotics is acquired by, or merges with, another company.
privacy_page.sec_security_body1: We apply physical, technical, and administrative safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the data involved, including encryption of data in transit, access controls on device and account data, and regular review of our security practices. No system is perfectly secure, and we can't guarantee absolute protection.
privacy_page.sec_retention_body1: We keep personal and device data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Diagnostic and telemetry logs are retained on a rolling basis and periodically purged.
privacy_page.sec_cookies_body1: Our website and apps use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember preferences, and measure aggregate traffic and usage. This information is analyzed at an aggregate level — we don't review it person by person.
privacy_page.sec_cookies_body2: You can disable cookies in your browser settings, or opt out of non-essential analytics from your account settings. Some features may not work correctly with cookies disabled.
privacy_page.sec_thirdparty_body1: Our site and apps may link to, or integrate with, services we don't control — payment processors, mapping providers, or social platforms. Their privacy practices are their own; we encourage you to review them before sharing information.
privacy_page.sec_children_body1: Our products and website are not directed at children. We don't knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13 without parental or guardian supervision.
privacy_page.sec_rights_body1: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information, and to withdraw consent you previously gave us. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below — we'll make a sincere effort to respond in a timely manner.
privacy_page.sec_transfers_body1: Because we operate across regions, your information may be processed in a country other than your own. Where we transfer data internationally, we take steps to ensure it receives a comparable level of protection.
privacy_page.sec_grievance_body1: If you have a complaint about how your information has been handled, write to us at the email below and we'll address it as quickly as we reasonably can.
privacy_page.sec_changes_body1: We may update this policy from time to time. We won't reduce your rights under this policy without your explicit consent, and we'll post any changes on this page along with a new effective date.
